Wraparound Care
Our Breakfast Club is run by school staff as a dedicated service for Winklebury Federation children, and is called Toast Squad. Breakfast Club opens from 7:30 and runs until registration and costs £4.50.
A selection of breakfast options are available along with cold drinks. Booking is made in advance online on Arbor and breakfast club adheres to all school policies.
A guide on how to book on Arbor is available here.
Please be aware that Breakfast Club must be paid for in advance.
Isis Out Of School Club provides wraparound after-school care on site to Winklebury students and pupils from other schools. Children stay within school and join Isis at 3:15pm.
Please see their website here: https://www.isisoosc.co.uk/
Or their Facebook page here: https://www.facebook.com/isisoosc
